description: Finds parcels by assessor parcel number (APN) in one county. Costs 1 credit per completed request, including no_match and ambiguous results. Up to 100 parcels per request. Validate each candidate before using it. Needs an API key. Lookups in counties we do not cover and failed requests cost no credits. Returns parcel records with WKT boundaries in EPSG:4326, owner, address, assessed values, land use and zoning where the county publishes them.

county.description: County name, 5-digit FIPS or 3-digit county code
county.title: County

match_mode.description: normalized ignores punctuation and case; exact needs the original identifier; contains (alpha) finds identifiers containing the input
match_mode.title: Match Mode

offset.description: Parcels to skip; each page is a new, charged request
offset.title: Offset

state.description: USPS code, state name or 2-digit FIPS; needed with a county name
state.title: State

name: find_parcels_by_apn
title: Find parcels by APN
